FactoryGuestRepositoryRead.description:
Asks the host plane for one commit of a repository the installation declares (W4H-28).

A guest never holds a repository credential and has no network. It names a source by the operator's own handle and one full commit id; the host fetches that commit with its own credential, reads the complete tree, seals it as a material of this attempt under the named operation, and answers the handle. The guest reads it with the material read frame.

commitSha.description: A full 40-hex commit id; a branch, a tag or a prefix is refused.

operationId.description: The journalled operation the sealed tree belongs to.

source.description: The `name` of a source the installation declares.
